title: Using illustrations in campaigns

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Choose illustration when it expresses an idea more directly than photography because the medium should serve the campaign concept.
strategic_value: Illustrative campaigns can give Helsinki room for invention while remaining part of its common identity.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section states the role of illustration in campaigns and shows credited illustration-only and mixed-media campaign examples.
practical_value: Choose the medium from the idea and check its relationship to Helsinki’s visual identity.
